select SEQ_NO id, GROUP_NAME text from SYS_BATCH_PRD_GRP where 1=1 --system_code = 'SYS'
AND GROUP_NAME like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%')

SELECT BOOKSET_ID id,BOOKSET_NAME text FROM BOK_BOOKSET where 1=1 AND BOOKSET_TYPE != '01'
AND BOOKSET_ID_TMPL = #{booksetIdTmpl}
AND (BOOKSET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR BOOKSET_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
order by bookset_type,BOOKSET_ID

SELECT BOOKSET_ID code,BOOKSET_NAME name,BOOKSET_NAME shortName,BOOKSET_ID hidCode FROM BOK_BOOKSET where 1=1
AND BOOKSET_TYPE in ('02','03')
AND (BOOKSET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')) OR BOOKSET_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')))
order by bookset_type,BOOKSET_ID
